# Pilot kit: logging specification

**Status: proposal.** What a pilot partner would record so that the repository's checks can score a real robot. Every rate below is an assumed, proposal value; a partner may log faster. Generated from `data/pilot_streams.csv` and `data/pilot_log_spec.csv`; JSON schemas for every file are in `docs/PILOT_KIT/schemas/` (generated by `tools/gen_log_schema.py`).

## General rules

- One folder per run, named by date and run label, holding the CSV files below. Comma separated, UTF-8, a header row with exactly the column names given, one row per sample, `t_s` increasing.
- Times are seconds since the start of the run, from one clock shared by every stream.
- Positions use one local frame for the whole run (east and north in metres from a fixed origin on site); headings use the same frame.
- Units are fixed by this page; never mix units in a column. Leave optional columns out rather than empty.
- Record what the robot actually measured. Do not smooth, resample or fill gaps; a gap is evidence.
- Keep the raw logs. The repository stores only the scoring results and their SHA-256, never personal data; if a camera sees people, record saturation values only, not images.

## Streams

| Stream | File | Minimum rate (Hz) | Purpose | Protocol items | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gnss | `gnss.csv` | 1 | Position fixes in a local frame for the GNSS fault checks | N1 N2 N3 N4 | assumed, proposal |
| odometry | `odometry.csv` | 10 | Wheel speed and heading that drive prediction between fixes | N2 N3 N4 | assumed, proposal |
| lidar_health | `lidar_health.csv` | 10 | Share of expected returns per scan for the dust monitor | DU2 DU3 DU4 DU5 | assumed, proposal |
| camera | `camera.csv` | 10 | Image saturation per frame and any slow command for the glare monitor | GL2 GL3 GL5 | assumed, proposal |
| thermal | `thermal.csv` | 1 | Component and ambient temperatures and the commanded scale | H1 H3 H4 H5 H6 | assumed, proposal |
| events | `events.csv` | on event | Every stop; park; derate; fault declaration; start and end of a run | all | assumed, proposal |

## Columns

### `gnss.csv`

| Column | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_s` | number | s | yes | Time since the start of the run |
| `x_m` | number | m | yes | East position in a local frame |
| `y_m` | number | m | yes | North position in a local frame |
| `fix_ok` | integer | flag | yes | 1 when the receiver reports a valid fix; 0 otherwise |
| `x_ref_m` | number | m | no | Reference east position from an independent source when available |
| `y_ref_m` | number | m | no | Reference north position from an independent source when available |

### `odometry.csv`

| Column | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_s` | number | s | yes | Time since the start of the run |
| `v_mps` | number | m/s | yes | Measured forward speed |
| `yaw_rad` | number | rad | yes | Heading in the same local frame as the fixes |

### `lidar_health.csv`

| Column | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_s` | number | s | yes | Time since the start of the run |
| `valid_return_ratio` | number | fraction | yes | Returns received over returns expected from the site map for this scan |
| `expected_beams` | integer | count | yes | Beams the map says should return |
| `window_state` | text | label | no | Documented window state such as clean or a named contamination |

### `camera.csv`

| Column | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_s` | number | s | yes | Time since the start of the run |
| `saturation_fraction` | number | fraction | yes | Share of saturated pixels in the frame |
| `slow_command` | integer | flag | yes | 1 when the monitor has commanded the slow speed |
| `sun_elevation_deg` | number | deg | no | Computed sun elevation at the time and place |
| `sun_azimuth_rel_deg` | number | deg | no | Computed sun azimuth relative to the heading |

### `thermal.csv`

| Column | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_s` | number | s | yes | Time since the start of the run |
| `ambient_c` | number | degC | yes | Air temperature near the robot |
| `compute_c` | number | degC | yes | Compute module temperature |
| `battery_c` | number | degC | yes | Battery temperature |
| `sensor_c` | number | degC | yes | Primary range sensor temperature |
| `scale` | number | fraction | yes | Commanded speed and power scale from 0 (parked) to 1 (full) |
| `shade` | integer | flag | no | 1 when the robot is in shade |

### `events.csv`

| Column | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_s` | number | s | yes | Time since the start of the run |
| `event` | text | label | yes | One of start; end; stop; estop; park; derate; slow; fault_declared |
| `note` | text | label | no | Free note by the test lead |

## Related repositories (linked, not copied)

- dhill (https://github.com/hudasol/dhill): field test kit and validation protocol for heat and dust envelopes; its README states that no licence is selected, so nothing is copied from it.
- marsad (https://github.com/hudasol/marsad): GNSS trust states and log replay for drones; Apache-2.0 per its repository; nothing is copied from it.
